rec.name: Recommended Products Carousel ("You'll also like this")
rec.status: Built — populated by the team before go-live (Oct 2025)

what.text: A horizontally scrolling carousel of product cards titled "Das wird dir auch gefallen" ("You'll also like this"). A small uppercase eyebrow above the heading reads "8 von 10 Kund*innen verwenden zusätzlich diese Sections" ("8 out of 10 customers also use these sections"). Prev/next arrow buttons sit at the top right. Each card shows a product image, a title, a short description, a 5-star rating with review count, the compare-at price struck through, the current price, and a green discount badge (e.g. -20%). The next card is partly visible at the right edge to signal that the row scrolls.

why.text: Showing a few relevant add-ons or alternatives at the decision point increases the chance of a second item and raises AOV. The eyebrow line ("8 out of 10 customers also use...") uses social proof and bandwagon effect to make the suggestion feel like a normal choice. Star ratings and review counts add credibility. The struck-through price and discount badge create a sense of deal value. The peeking card invites scrolling and discovery.

how.text: Build a carousel section in the theme using the native Shopify recommendations source. Curate each product's recommended products manually in the Shopify "Search & Discovery" app, with 3 relevant, product-specific picks per article as the initial brief. In comments, the developer advised linking at least 4 products per article so the cards fill the row with even spacing to the edge, and this was approved. Card content comes from standard product data: image, title, description, rating (review app or metafield), price, compare-at price and a computed discount badge. Add prev/next arrow buttons and let the last card peek in.

items: Number of recommended products per product (minimum 4 recommended so the row fills evenly)
Show or hide the star rating and review count
Show or hide the compare-at price and the discount badge
Manual curation via Search & Discovery vs. automatic recommendations

dependencies.text: Shopify Search & Discovery app for manual product recommendations (each product needs at least 4 recommended items, set up per product). A review/rating source for stars and review count, plus compare-at prices for the discount badge (not specified in ticket). The eyebrow claim ("8 of 10 customers") needs to be backed by real data. A theme that supports the product-recommendations section.

items: Click-through rate on recommended product cards

images.caption: Carousel with eyebrow social-proof line, heading, prev/next arrows and cards showing image, title, description, rating, struck-through price, current price and a -20% badge. The fourth card peeks in at the right edge.
